intent: Specify the public addition / subtraction / negation API of `ruint::Uint<BITS, LIMBS>` (module `ruint::add`): `overflowing_add`, `overflowing_sub`, `overflowing_neg`, `wrapping_add`, `wrapping_sub`, `wrapping_neg`, `checked_add`, `checked_sub`, `checked_neg`, `strict_add`, `strict_sub`, `strict_neg`, `saturating_add`, `saturating_sub`, the by-value `Add`, `Sub` and `Neg` operator impls, together with `Uint::from_limbs`, the constants `Uint::ZERO` and `Uint::MAX`, and the free functions `ruint::mask` and `ruint::nlimbs`.

manual_mutants.note: overflow flag ignores bits carried into the masked-off part of the top limb (only wrong for widths that are not multiples of 64)
off-by-one in the top-limb overflow test: a top limb equal to MASK is reported as an overflow
mask(0) returns u64::MAX instead of 0 (zero-width types unaffected because they never mask)
from_limbs rejects a top limb equal to MASK (e.g. the maximum value)
MAX built with the checked constructor: panics for widths that are not multiples of 64 (and so does saturating_add on overflow)
carry lost when the limb sum is u64::MAX and a carry comes in (only visible with rippling carries)
borrow lost when two limbs are equal and a borrow comes in (only visible with rippling borrows)

bug_variants.source: injected regression (promoted manual mutant #0); no usable historical fix found upstream
bug_variants.note: overflow flag of overflowing_add only reports the carry out of the last limb and ignores bits carried into the masked-off part of the top limb: for widths that are not a multiple of 64 an overflowing sum is reported as non-overflowing (checked_add returns Some of a wrapped value, saturating_add / strict_add / `+` do not saturate / panic)
